svg.title: Linking a document from the smart picker
svg.desc: jamie types / in Text and chooses Paperless documents. The picker sends the term invoice to the search provider of the app, which asks Paperless-ngx and answers with the documents whose file jamie can open, each with the link /f/412 of its file. jamie picks a result, and the picker inserts that link. When someone reads the page, Nextcloud's own provider of file links renders the link: as the preview of the file for a reader who can open the file, and as the bare link for anyone else.
